description: This chart is a histogram illustrating the distribution of "Pass@1" scores as a "Percentage". The horizontal axis contains the continuous categories, labeled "Pass@1", featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The vertical value axis is labeled "Percentage" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1 and corresponding light gray horizontal grid lines. The data is represented by five contiguous light blue bars with black outlines, ordered sequentially by their Pass@1 intervals from left to right. The first bar, spanning 0.0 to 0.2, is annotated with "11.2%". The second and third bars, spanning 0.2 to 0.4 and 0.4 to 0.6 respectively, are the shortest in the chart, each annotated with "3.4%". The fourth bar, spanning 0.6 to 0.8, is annotated with "5.8%". The fifth and final bar, spanning 0.8 to 1.0, is the tallest, annotated with "76.2%". The chart includes a vertical dashed red line at approximately 0.82 on the horizontal axis, labeled with red text reading "mean: 0.82" to its left. Additionally, a small gray rectangular marker is present on the y-axis just above the 0.0 mark.
